asideTitle: Your data never leaves this page

faq.a: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you paste is uploaded, stored, or sent anywhere.
faq.q: Is my input sent to a server?

faq.a: Yes — decoding happens entirely in your browser with JavaScript; the token never leaves your device. As a general rule, still avoid pasting production tokens into any tool you don't control.
faq.q: Is it safe to paste a token here?

faq.a: No. This tool decodes the header and payload only. A decoded token proves nothing about authenticity — always verify signatures server-side with the issuer's keys.

heroSubtitle: Paste a JSON Web Token to read its header and claims — and see at a glance whether it has expired.
metaDescription: Decode a JWT's header and payload instantly and check its expiry. Decoding happens 100% in your browser — tokens are never sent anywhere.
title: JWT Decoder — Decode JSON Web Tokens Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Never trust a token just because it decodes — decoding is not verification, and an attacker can craft any payload they like.
Encrypted tokens (JWE, five segments) cannot be decoded without the key — this tool handles signed JWTs (three segments) only.
